name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: Protects confidential information both parties share while exploring or running a business relationship.

coverPage.title: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
coverPage.intro: This Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (the “MNDA”) consists of: (1) this Cover Page (“**Cover Page**”) and (2) the Common Paper Mutual NDA Standard Terms Version 1.0 (“**Standard Terms**”) identical to those posted at [commonpaper.com/standards/mutual-nda/1.0](https://commonpaper.com/standards/mutual-nda/1.0). Any modifications of the Standard Terms should be made on the Cover Page, which will control over conflicts with the Standard Terms.
coverPage.attestation: By signing this Cover Page, each party agrees to enter into this MNDA as of the Effective Date.
coverPage.attribution: Common Paper Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Version 1.0) free to use under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

fields.label: Purpose
fields.note: How Confidential Information may be used
fields.default: Evaluating whether to enter into a business relationship with the other party.
fields.prompt: what the parties may use each other's confidential information for, in one sentence.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.prompt: the date the NDA starts, as yyyy-mm-dd.

fields.label: MNDA Term

options.label: Expires {years} from Effective Date.
options.formLabel: year(s) from the effective date, then expires

options.label: Continues until terminated in accordance with the terms of the MNDA.
options.formLabel: Continues until terminated by either party

fields.prompt: "expires" when the NDA runs a fixed number of years, "untilTerminated" when it continues until someone ends it.

fields.label: Term of Confidentiality
fields.note: How long Confidential Information is protected

options.label: {years} from Effective Date, but in the case of trade secrets until Confidential Information is no longer considered a trade secret under applicable laws.
options.formLabel: year(s) from the effective date (trade secrets protected longer)

fields.prompt: "years" for a fixed confidentiality period, "perpetual" for indefinitely.

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.prompt: the full name of the US state whose law governs, such as "Delaware". Always a state, never a country or a city.

fields.label: Jurisdiction
fields.placeholder: Fill in city or county and state
fields.prompt: the city or county and state where disputes are heard, such as "New Castle, DE".

fields.label: MNDA Modifications
fields.note: List any modifications to the MNDA
fields.hint: Optional. Anything here controls over the standard terms.
fields.prompt: changes to the standard terms. Usually there are none.

fields.label: Party 1
fields.prompt: the company's legal entity name, the signatory's name and title, and a notice address (an email or a postal address).

fields.label: Party 2
fields.prompt: the company's legal entity name, the signatory's name and title, and a notice address (an email or a postal address).
